svg.text: wr_en / wrdata timing - cmd +tphy_wrlat -> en , +tphy_wrdata -> data

svg.text: WR0@0, WR1@13 (gap). wrlat=4, wrdata=2. en leads data by wrdata; both gap with spacing.
